title: Gerente comercial — vaga afirmativa para mulheres
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente comercial — vaga afirmativa para mulheres em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Gerente Comercial — Vaga afirmativa para mulheres      Modelo: remoto | tempo integral    Remuneração: R$ 5.000 fixos + variável progressiva de 1% a 4%    Área: Comercial / Revenue    Empresa: Global Pathway      Sobre a Global Pathway      A Global Pathway é uma empresa de reposicionamento profissional internacional.      Preparamos profissionais e executivos brasileiros para competirem por oportunidades no mercado americano, construírem carreiras em moeda forte e ampliarem suas possibilidades profissionais dentro ou fora do Brasil.      Nosso trabalho envolve estratégia de carreira, posicionamento profissional, currículo, Linked In, preparação para entrevistas, inglês aplicado ao mercado de trabalho e acompanhamento durante a jornada de transição internacional.      Estamos construindo algo maior do que uma operação de cursos e mentorias. Nossa visão inclui comunidade, tecnologia, banco de talentos, produtos executivos, parcerias com recrutadores e empresas, eventos e novas frentes de expansão internacional.      Para liderar a próxima fase da nossa operação comercial, buscamos uma Gerente Comercial com experiência em vendas consultivas, gestão de pessoas, processos e indicadores.      Missão da posição      Construir, liderar e desenvolver uma operação comercial previsível, escalável e orientada a resultados, garantindo que Social Sellers, SDRs e Closers trabalhem com método, clareza, disciplina e excelência na experiência do cliente.      Essa profissional será responsável por transformar estratégia em execução, acompanhar todo o funil comercial e assegurar que as metas de receita sejam alcançadas sem comprometer a ética, a qualidade das vendas ou a reputação da Global Pathway.      Não buscamos apenas alguém para cobrar metas.      Buscamos uma líder capaz de:     •⁠ ⁠desenvolver pessoas;   •⁠ ⁠estruturar processos;   •⁠ ⁠interpretar dados;   •⁠ ⁠corrigir gargalos;   •⁠ ⁠melhorar conversões;   •⁠ ⁠construir previsibilidade;   •⁠ ⁠elevar o padrão comercial da empresa.      Principais responsabilidades     •⁠ ⁠Liderar o time de Social Seller, SDR e Closer.   •⁠ ⁠Definir metas individuais e coletivas.   •⁠ ⁠Acompanhar diariamente pipeline, conversões, receita e produtividade.   •⁠ ⁠Realizar reuniões diárias, semanais e mensais de performance.   •⁠ ⁠Construir e atualizar playbooks, scripts, cadências e processos comerciais.   •⁠ ⁠Garantir o uso correto do CRM e a qualidade das informações registradas.   •⁠ ⁠Analisar a jornada completa do lead, da primeira interação ao fechamento.   •⁠ ⁠Identificar gargalos entre geração de leads, qualificação, agendamento, comparecimento e venda.   •⁠ ⁠Desenvolver treinamentos, roleplays e planos individuais de evolução.   •⁠ ⁠Auditar mensagens, calls comerciais, follow-ups e negociações.   •⁠ ⁠Acompanhar indicadores de show rate, conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de venda e receita recebida.   •⁠ ⁠Produzir forecast semanal e mensal.   •⁠ ⁠Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing, Growth, Produto e Founders.   •⁠ ⁠Garantir alinhamento entre campanhas, ICP, capacidade operacional e metas comerciais.   •⁠ ⁠Apoiar negociações estratégicas e vendas de maior ticket.   •⁠ ⁠Avaliar a qualidade das vendas e reduzir cancelamentos, inadimplência, reembolsos e chargebacks.   •⁠ ⁠Contratar, integrar e desenvolver novas profissionais do time comercial.   •⁠ ⁠Criar planos de rampagem para SDRs, Social Sellers e Closers.   •⁠ ⁠Estruturar campanhas de reativação de leads e recuperação de oportunidades.   •⁠ ⁠Apresentar diagnósticos e planos de ação para a liderança.   •⁠ ⁠Contribuir para novas frentes de receita, produtos premium, eventos, B2 B e expansão internacional.      Rotina esperada      Diariamente     •⁠ ⁠Revisar indicadores e pipeline.   •⁠ ⁠Conduzir reunião rápida com o time.   •⁠ ⁠Identificar oportunidades críticas e gargalos.   •⁠ ⁠Acompanhar agendas e resultados de SDRs e Closers.   •⁠ ⁠Auditar amostras de conversas e calls.   •⁠ ⁠Apoiar negociações relevantes.   •⁠ ⁠Garantir atualização do CRM.   •⁠ ⁠Reportar riscos, bloqueios e prioridades.      Semanalmente     •⁠ ⁠Realizar reunião de Revenue.   •⁠ ⁠Apresentar forecast e projeção de fechamento.   •⁠ ⁠Revisar resultados por canal, produto e profissional.   •⁠ ⁠Conduzir roleplays e treinamentos.   •⁠ ⁠Avaliar leads ganhos e perdidos.   •⁠ ⁠Dar feedback individual ao time.   •⁠ ⁠Alinhar campanhas e metas com Marketing e Growth.   •⁠ ⁠Atualizar plano de ação da operação.      Mensalmente     •⁠ ⁠Fechar resultados comerciais.   •⁠ ⁠Avaliar atingimento das metas.   •⁠ ⁠Revisar capacidade do time.   •⁠ ⁠Construir plano do próximo ciclo.   •⁠ ⁠Apresentar análise de receita, conversão e produtividade aos Founders.   •⁠ ⁠Propor contratações, ajustes de processo e novas estratégias.      Metas iniciais da posição      As metas finais serão calibradas de acordo com o volume de leads, ticket e maturidade da operação. Como referência, esperamos que a Gerente Comercial seja capaz de conduzir o time para:     •⁠ ⁠atingir a meta mensal de receita recebida;   •⁠ ⁠manter forecast com variação máxima aproximada de 15%;   •⁠ ⁠alcançar taxa de comparecimento em calls igual ou superior a 75%;   •⁠ ⁠manter taxa de fechamento entre 25% e 30% sobre oportunidades qualificadas;   •⁠ ⁠garantir que 100% das oportunidades ativas tenham próxima ação registrada;   •⁠ ⁠manter CRM com alto nível de atualização e confiabilidade;   •⁠ ⁠reduzir leads sem retorno ou sem acompanhamento;   •⁠ ⁠manter índice de reembolso, cancelamento ou chargeback inferior a 5%, desconsiderando problemas comprovadamente relacionados à entrega;   •⁠ ⁠desenvolver planos de melhoria para profissionais abaixo da meta;   •⁠ ⁠aumentar progressivamente a receita por lead e a eficiência do funil;   •⁠ ⁠garantir que toda venda esteja alinhada ao perfil correto de cliente.      Indicadores acompanhados     •⁠ ⁠Receita contratada.   •⁠ ⁠Receita efetivamente recebida.   •⁠ ⁠Atingimento de meta.   •⁠ ⁠Conversão por etapa do funil.   •⁠ ⁠Reuniões agendadas.   •⁠ ⁠Reuniões realizadas.   •⁠ ⁠Show rate.   •⁠ ⁠Taxa de fechamento.   •⁠ ⁠Ticket médio.   •⁠ ⁠Ciclo médio de venda.   •⁠ ⁠Pipeline gerado.   •⁠ ⁠Receita por profissional.   •⁠ ⁠Receita por canal.   •⁠ ⁠Qualidade da qualificação.   •⁠ ⁠Número médio de follow-ups.   •⁠ ⁠Forecast.   •⁠ ⁠Inadimplência.   •⁠ ⁠Cancelamentos.   •⁠ ⁠Reembolsos.   •⁠ ⁠Chargebacks.   •⁠ ⁠Produtividade do time.   •⁠ ⁠Qualidade do CRM.      Remuneração      Salário fixo: R$ 5.000 por mês.      Remuneração variável: de 1% a 4%, vinculada ao resultado da operação comercial sob sua gestão.      Modelo progressivo sugerido     •⁠ ⁠1%: atingimento entre 80% e 99% da meta;   •⁠ ⁠2%: atingimento entre 100% e 115% da meta;   •⁠ ⁠3%: atingimento entre 116% e 130% da meta;   •⁠ ⁠4%: atingimento igual ou superior a 131% da meta.      A variável deverá ser calculada sobre a receita efetivamente recebida, e não apenas sobre contratos assinados.      O pagamento também estará condicionado à qualidade das vendas, ao controle do CRM e aos limites definidos para inadimplência, reembolsos e cancelamentos.      As regras completas de remuneração variável serão apresentadas antes da contratação.      O que esperamos de você     •⁠ ⁠Experiência comprovada em gestão comercial.   •⁠ ⁠Vivência com SDRs, Social Sellers, Closers ou inside sales.   •⁠ ⁠Experiência com vendas consultivas.   •⁠ ⁠Domínio de CRM, pipeline, metas e forecast.   •⁠ ⁠Capacidade de liderar, cobrar e desenvolver pessoas.   •⁠ ⁠Perfil analítico e orientado a dados.   •⁠ ⁠Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.   •⁠ ⁠Capacidade de transformar estratégia em plano operacional.   •⁠ ⁠Organização e disciplina de gestão.   •⁠ ⁠Segurança para conduzir conversas difíceis.   •⁠ ⁠Maturidade para atuar diretamente com Founders.   •⁠ ⁠Responsabilidade com a promessa comercial e com a experiência do cliente.   •⁠ ⁠Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto em jornada integral.   •⁠ ⁠Computador, internet estável e ambiente adequado para reuniões.      Diferenciais     •⁠ ⁠Experiência com vendas high ticket.   •⁠ ⁠Experiência em educação, mentoria, consultoria, recrutamento ou desenvolvimento profissional.   •⁠ ⁠Conhecimento de SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale, GPCT ou metodologias semelhantes.   •⁠ ⁠Experiência com construção de playbooks.   •⁠ ⁠Experiência em contratação e rampagem de times.   •⁠ ⁠Familiaridade com produtos digitais e serviços premium.   •⁠ ⁠Conhecimento sobre carreira internacional e mercado americano.   •⁠ ⁠Inglês fluente será um diferencial importante.      Perfil comportamental      Buscamos uma mulher que combine:     •⁠ ⁠liderança com responsabilidade;   •⁠ ⁠cobrança com desenvolvimento;   •⁠ ⁠empatia com firmeza;   •⁠ ⁠ambição com ética;   •⁠ ⁠autonomia com prestação de contas;   •⁠ ⁠visão estratégica com capacidade de execução.      A profissional ideal não espera os problemas aparecerem no fechamento do mês. Ela acompanha os dados, antecipa riscos e conduz o time para a solução.      Possibilidades de crescimento      A Global Pathway está em fase de estruturação e expansão.      Uma profissional de alta performance poderá evoluir para posições como:     •⁠ ⁠Head Comercial;   •⁠ ⁠Head of Sales;   •⁠ ⁠Head of Revenue;   •⁠ ⁠Diretora Comercial;   •⁠ ⁠liderança de novas unidades de negócio;   •⁠ ⁠liderança de expansão B2 B e internacional.      Também poderá participar da construção de novas frentes, como produtos executivos, banco de talentos, parcerias com empresas internacionais, eventos e expansão para outros mercados.      Nossa cultura      A Global Pathway acredita que o talento brasileiro não deve ficar limitado ao mercado que o subvaloriza.      Ajudamos profissionais a construírem carreiras internacionais, aumentarem sua renda, conquistarem liberdade geográfica e ampliarem suas possibilidades de vida.      Mas não vendemos ilusões.      Não prometemos emprego, visto ou contratação garantida por terceiros. Vendemos preparação, posicionamento, método, estratégia e acompanhamento.      Nossa Gerente Comercial será uma das principais guardiãs dessa cultura.      Ela deverá garantir que o time comercial venda o sonho possível sem distorcer a realidade, respeitando cada lead e protegendo a reputação da empresa.        Venha liderar o time que está ajudando profissionais brasileiros a construir uma carreira internacional e uma nova vida em moeda forte.

Nosso time é movido por desafios, inovação e aquele brilho nos olhos de quem sabe que tá fazendo história. Já pensou fazer parte de algo gigante assim?      Aqui, sua carreira pode crescer tanto quanto a gente. Bora?      Conheça o nosso manifesto:    O mundo é movido por pessoas que fazem acontecer.    Fazer acontecer é uma maneira de viver.    Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.    Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças.    Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação.    É nisso que acreditamos. title: Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled
description:
Nova oportunidade para Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Emperor Rentals is a U. S. vacation-rental and real-estate business seeking a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager based in Brazil for a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time. You will work with our Portuguese-speaking team and communicate clearly in English with U. S. management and our external accountant.      This is a very hands-on individual-contributor role. You will personally perform day-to-day bookkeeping and financial housekeeping: clean up transactions, organize receipts, reconcile accounts, prepare owner statements, and produce recurring reports. You will own follow-through from source documents to accurate books and completed reporting. You will also improve these financial workflows using AI.      COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE    USD $250 per week. Required schedule: FULL-TIME, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time (New York time, following Eastern daylight-saving changes). You must be available for this fixed schedule; general time-zone overlap is not sufficient. Confirm your availability and acceptance of this weekly budget in your proposal. Long-term collaboration is intended, subject to performance and mutual agreement.      WHAT YOU WILL OWN   - Daily Quick Books Online bookkeeping across separate legal entities: bank/card feeds, accurate categories, property classes, receipts, and an aged exception list.   - Bank and credit-card reconciliations to actual statements, with every difference explained and supporting documents retained.   - Owner Rez accounting: reconcile property expenses and owner statements to Quick Books, distinguish reimbursements from service income, and prepare weekly property-management transfer schedules for approval.   - Keep guest/owner trust funds, operating cash, intercompany transfers, owner distributions, and business income correctly separated.   - Reconcile Airbnb, Vrbo, , Stripe and other payouts, fees, commissions, refunds and chargebacks to bookings and bank deposits.   - Prepare monthly owner statements and property-level reports, apply review corrections promptly, and track completion through final approval.   - Support weekly payroll and contractor-payment reconciliation across time/work records, payment-provider records and the bank, including fees and failed or duplicate payments.   - Retrieve mortgage and utility support, prepare principal/interest/escrow allocations, and maintain property-specific records.   - Deliver monthly P& L, balance-sheet support, reconciliation schedules and a clear list of unresolved items. Support W-9/1099 preparation under the external accountant's approved instructions.      AI-ASSISTED ACCOUNTING   - Use approved AI tools to help extract invoice data, propose transaction classifications, compare exports, investigate differences, draft reports and document procedures.   - Build repeatable spreadsheet and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.   - Verify every AI-generated calculation, classification and proposed entry against source documents. Keep a clear audit trail and follow company data-access policies.   - Retain personal responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the books, and obtain required approval before posting adjustments or releasing payments.      REQUIRED EXPERIENCE   - At least 3 years of hands-on U. S. bookkeeping/accounting and Quick Books Online, with ownership of reconciliations, monthly close and financial reporting.   - Either practical experience using AI tools in finance/accounting, OR a strong willingness to learn and consistently use AI in our financial workflows. Prior AI expertise is not required; careful verification, curiosity and adoption of our tools are required.   - Strong bank reconciliation, double-entry accounting, balance-sheet cleanup and multi-entity experience.   - Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling large exports.   - Professional Portuguese and strong written/spoken English. Based in Brazil for team collaboration and working-hour alignment.   - Ability to spot duplicates, missing receipts, incorrect periods, wrong properties and unsupported classifications without waiting for the owner to find them.   - Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and willingness to use Hubstaff for agreed work-time reporting.      STRONGLY PREFERRED    Property management, vacation rentals, real estate or trust/owner accounting; Owner Rez; OTA/Stripe payout reconciliation; Quick Books Pro Advisor certification; familiarity with Slack, Notion, Operto or similar operations tools. An accounting degree is welcome.      HOW WE DEFINE GOOD WORK    Accurate reconciliations, clear evidence and dependable completion dates. Review new bank-feed items each business day and process supported items within one business day where possible. Escalate missing information with an owner and due date. Reconcile before declaring work complete. Flag unclear instructions, explain accounting implications, document decisions and improve repetitive workflows. Payment release and tax decisions remain subject to management/accountant approval.      TO APPLY   1. Describe your U. S. Quick Books and property-management experience, including the number of entities/accounts you managed.   2. Explain how you would handle a property repair paid by Operations and later reimbursed from owner funds without double-counting income.   3. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered, how you proved it and how you prevented recurrence.   4. Explain your monthly-close checklist and how you track missing receipts and unresolved differences.   5. Describe how you currently use AI, or confirm your willingness to learn and use AI in our financial workflows. Explain how you would check its output for accuracy.   6. Confirm your location in Brazil, English/Portuguese proficiency, availability for the full-time Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern schedule, and acceptance of USD $250 per week.      Please share only anonymized examples with no client financial details. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a separately agreed paid practical exercise using sample data. We value sound judgment, careful work and clear communication.

title: Finance review lead (consultant)
description:
Empresa está contratando Finance review lead (consultant) em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Brazil (remote)   Start date: September 2026    Term: initial fixed-term Consultancy project until February 2027, with potential for further work      About the Green Finance Institute (GFI)    Established in 2019, the Green Finance Institute (GFI) is an independent advisor to governments and investors. It is at the forefront of shaping how finance can be used to facilitate a real economy transition, by designing, testing, and scaling financial solutions that enable capital to flow where it can deliver the greatest impact in the real economy.      The GFI delivers positive outcomes for climate and nature by aligning policy, capital and pipeline development. As a commercially focused philanthropic organisation working with governments and partnering with financial institutions, corporates, NGOs, policymakers, academics and civil society experts, the GFI has mobilised over £80bn in committed capital to date.      The GFI is headquartered in London and has a presence in eight countries including Belgium, Brazil, Denmark, Indonesia, the Philippines, Scotland, South Africa and Spain, and its missions work across the built environment, carbon dioxide removals, industrial decarbonisation, energy, transportation and nature.      Project Overview    This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced project finance and transaction advisory professional to support the establishment, launch and early delivery of the Brazil Project Preparation Facility (PPF).      The Financial Review Lead is responsible for converting project information into robust financial and transaction analysis that supports progression from initial bankability assessment to an investor-ready capital structure and, where applicable, transaction execution. The role provides operational support across the financial and transaction advisory workstream, works closely with the Financial & Transactions Advisory Analyst team, and ensures that project economics, financing assumptions, capital structures, blended-finance options and investor requirements are assessed consistently across the active pipeline.      During the September 2026 to February 2027 pre-launch phase, the role will support the establishment and launch of the facility by reviewing project information, translating it into financial models and contributing to the financial assessment of submissions.      Scope of Work Lead the financial and transaction advisory workstream and support the analyst team, providing coordination and quality control across the active pipeline. Translate project information into bankable financial models and analysis covering project economics, revenues, development, capital and operating costs, financing scenarios, sensitivities and assumptions. Identify financial and bankability gaps and determine the financing requirements needed to progress projects toward final investment decision readiness. Develop and review capital structures, ensuring that financing assumptions remain consistent with project design, operating parameters, costs, performance and technical risks. Design blended and concessional finance solutions, including first-loss provisions, guarantees, subordinated debt, results-based finance and other appropriate de-risking instruments. Map eligible MDB, bilateral and climate-fund sources and structure concessional participation to maximise additionality, minimise market distortion and preserve commercial co-financing. Assess projects against DFI and institutional-investor criteria, appraisal methodologies and documentation requirements, and oversee investor-facing financial materials. Coordinate financial outputs with technical and transaction advisory inputs, maintaining consistency across the capital stack, blended-finance instruments and transaction documentation. Oversee the transition from financial structuring into transaction execution, including transaction structuring, documentation, investor engagement, market sounding and negotiation support through financial close. Support the financial review of submissions under the agreed application process, whether single-stage or two-stage, without assuming project-approval authority.    Consultant Profile Significant professional experience in project finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, development finance, infrastructure finance or a comparable financial advisory role. Demonstrable experience developing and reviewing complex project financial models, including revenue, cost, financing, sensitivity and scenario analysis. Strong understanding of project bankability, capital structuring, commercial financing and the requirements of institutional investors and lenders. Experience designing or assessing blended-finance and concessional-finance structures and appropriate de-risking instruments. Experience assessing project information and translating technical, operational and commercial inputs into clear financial analysis and recommendations. Strong quality-control and coordination skills, with the ability to guide analysts and maintain consistent standards across multiple projects and workstreams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Sound judgement, discretion and the ability to operate with autonomy while maintaining clear communication with the PPF Director and wider team. Professional fluency in English. Portuguese language skills are strongly advantageous.    Project Governance and Role Boundaries    The PPF Director will retain overall programme leadership and responsibility for institutional relationships and formal reporting to government, stakeholders and funders. The Financial Review Lead will lead the financial and transaction advisory workstream, coordinate its outputs and provide financial input to programme and project decisions within the agreed mandate.    The Financial Review Lead will work closely with, but will not replace, the distinct technical, legal, policy, operational or institutional mandates assigned to other PPF roles and specialist workstreams. Formal project-selection and approval authority will remain with the relevant governance bodies in accordance with the approved governance structure.      How to Apply    Please apply by submitting your CV and a short cover letter of no more than two sides. Your cover letter should include details of:   your relevant professional experience; how you meet the broader requirements of opportunity.    CVs without a cover letter will not be considered.      Please apply by emailing   by COB 14th September 2026.      Please note that is a consulting engagement. You will be contracted by GFI either as an individual consultant, through your own limited company or via a local agent. You will therefore be responsible for managing your own tax obligations and will not be entitled to local employment benefits. As a consultant, you will determine the manner and method of delivering the services, while working collaboratively with GFI and key stakeholders to achieve agreed outcomes.

title: Partnerships manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Partnerships manager em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership    You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.    Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.    That's where you come in.      The Role — In Plain English    You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.    This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.    Your week might look like this:   Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing.  You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.      What Makes This Different    Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.    You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.    Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.      You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in Saa S, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you    What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job    If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.    Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

Tenha autonomia para conduzir problemas e transformar direcionamentos em soluções. Seja familiarizado(a) com Figma, Notion e Miro. We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors. Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.  This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.  MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:   Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.  Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.  Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.  Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.  Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.  Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.  Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.  Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.    MUST HAVE:   Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.  Positive leadership qualities.  Exceptional interpersonal skills.  Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).  Fluency in English.  Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).  Deep understanding of current trends in XR, gaming, and entertainment industries, influencing user expectations and behaviors.  Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.    NICE TO HAVE:   Familiarity with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack, and Github.  Fluency in Portuguese.  Previous experience with VR and AR content is desirable.  A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences.  Knowledge of other project management techniques.  Experience in a technology or content development environment.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Data Scientist em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA   A diretoria de Data & Analytics na Blip é responsável por empoderar a empresa na geração de conhecimento, guiando-a em tomadas de decisão data-driven e impulsionando a inovação através dos dados. Tem, portanto, um papel fundamental na evolução da Blip.  Nossa área de Data for Services tem como missão gerar valor para nossos clientes por meio da implementação de serviços de dados de alto valor agregado, com foco em diagnósticos aplicados, modelagem estatística, análises preditivas e prescritivas. Atuamos intencionalmente para impulsionar a satisfação dos clientes, fortalecer o uso de dados desde o design na plataforma e promover experiências hiperpersonalizadas.  Como Cientista de Dados Sênior, esperamos que você seja referência técnica em ciência de dados e práticas de Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), atuando na concepção e implementação de soluções analíticas escaláveis, conduzindo experimentos avançados, compartilhando conhecimento e acompanhando tendências do setor para garantir excelência técnica e impacto de negócio.  Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e tem dúvidas se pode se candidatar, saiba que todas as vagas da Blip são também para pessoas com deficiência. Estamos esperando sua inscrição!  RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES   Conduzir e liderar estudos analíticos avançados, utilizando métodos estatísticos e Data Science para identificar padrões ocultos, prever comportamentos e maximizar o valor e os resultados estratégicos do negócio.  Traduzir problemas de negócio complexos em hipóteses analíticas rigorosas e soluções data-driven de alto impacto.  Projetar, desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos preditivos e prescritivos de ponta (ex: regressão, classificação, séries temporais).  Garantir a robustez e a sustentabilidade dos modelos em produção, aplicando as melhores práticas de MLOps, versionamento de modelos, monitoramento e re-treinamento automatizado.  Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de Engenharia de Dados e Product Managers (DPMs) para otimizar pipelines de dados de feature engineering e viabilizar a aplicação de modelos em escala e com baixa latência.  Contribuir diretamente para a evolução da arquitectura analítica e da governança de dados e modelos, sugerindo melhorias em processos, infraestrutura e padrões técnicos.  Liderar experimentos e provas de conceito de inovação em IA aplicada a negócios, como NLP, previsão de demanda, detecção de anomalias e sistemas de recomendação.  Atuar como mentor técnico, disseminando o conhecimento e as melhores práticas de Ciência de Dados por meio de oficinas, code reviews e liderança de projetos complexos.  Estimular e ser um agente de transformação na promoção de uma cultura analítica, garantindo que as decisões em toda a empresa sejam fundamentadas em evidências e dados de alta qualidade. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Software Engineer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Zippi  A Zippi  tem como missão ajudar a impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito , permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa mais saudável para suas operações. Desde o nosso lançamento, alcançamos a lucratividade e experimentamos um crescimento exponencial . Hoje, processamos mais de R$ 3,4 bilhões em pagamentos por ano  e estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de crédito no mercado brasileiro de MPEs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 1,6 trilhão ao ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa. Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global,  estamos formando um time de tecnologia de classe mundial para construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca uma oportunidade de causar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena , em uma das fintechs que mais cresce em mercados emergentes, enfrentando um desafio multibilionário - a Zippi é o lugar certo pra você. Sobre o Time  Somos um time coeso e de alta performance  sempre com foco em entregar valor para os nossos clientes . Aqui, as pessoas engenheiras possuem um papel estratégico, participando de projetos de alto impacto, focando na geração de valor do produto e na entrega de soluções sustentáveis. Em parceria direta com produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio, garantindo que as pessoas engenheiras tenham contexto amplo para tomar decisões que geram valor real para o negócio da Zippi. Sua Missão  Na Zippi, sua missão será atuar junto aos times de produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio para transformar insights de mercado e necessidades dos nossos usuários em soluções tecnológicas de ponta. Você deverá: Entender as dores e os comportamentos dos MPEs  que usam nosso produto, propondo hipóteses de melhoria com base em dados e feedback real. Colaborar em equipes multifuncionais  (produto, design, dados, negócios), traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções e fluxos de dados que garantam alta performance, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade. Priorizar entregas de forma orientada a resultados , equilibrando velocidade e qualidade; medir o impacto das suas entregas por meio de métricas claras (retenção, conversão, satisfação). Assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de alto impacto , propondo soluções criativas, resilientes e escaláveis no longo prazo. Trabalhar de ponta a ponta: do desenho de protótipos à instrumentação em produção,  passando por testes automatizados e ajustes rápidos próprios de um ambiente ágil.  O que buscamos  Mentalidade de Produto : você pensa além do “faça funcionar” e questiona “isso resolve o problema certo?”. Foco em Resultados : orienta suas decisões por métricas de negócio e pelo sucesso do usuário, não apenas por linhas de código entregues. Comunicação Clara : sabe alinhar visões técnicas e de produto, facilitando discussões e tomando decisões conjuntas com outras áreas. Versatilidade em Tecnologia : tem experiência sólida em alguma stack moderna, e sem apego a ferramentas ou linguagens específicas. Autonomia e Protagonismo : assume responsabilidades, conduz experimentos A/B, itera rápido e aprende com os resultados, sem depender de micro-gestão. Curiosidade e Evolução Contínua : busca novas tecnologias, melhores práticas e tendências de mercado, elevando o patamar técnico e de produto do nosso ecossistema.  Por que vir para a Zippi?  Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar : nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções. Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia : como um early team member, você terá papel essencial na criação da área de crescimento de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada pela YCombinator. Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa : aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.  O que você pode esperar da gente!  Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado; Participação em nosso programa de Stock Options; Learning Budget anual; Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros (as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade; Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos; Vale-refeição no Caju; Férias flexíveis; Wellhub e Zenklub; Trabalho 100% remoto.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experience in project management and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.    Preferred Qualifications   Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field.  Experience in specific industries such as finance, healthcare, or technology.  Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.  Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerência de Gestão de Risco Rodoviário e Prevenção de Perdas

Gerência de Gestão de Risco Rodoviário e Prevenção de Perdas  Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a logística e a forma de fazer entregas no Brasil. Queremos empoderar pessoas e transformar negócios com entregas de excelência. Movimentamos mais de 500 mil pacotes por dia com uma tecnologia de ponta a ponta, que aproxima todos os cantos do país. Temos o propósito de que as entregas sejam acessíveis para todas as pessoas do Brasil. Esse é nosso desafio diário, por isso, buscamos inovação em tudo que fazemos. Por aqui, valorizamos diferentes formas de pensar, pois sabemos que só assim podemos criar o futuro.  Nossa Cultura  Nossa cultura é traduzida pelos comportamentos de cada Logger e pelas experiências que construímos com nossos clientes e sociedade. Somos conduzidos por quatro valores: Criamos o futuro, Entregamos soluções simples, Comunicamos abertamente e Vivemos o diferente . Eles guiam o comportamento no ambiente de trabalho.  Nossos Valores no Time de Operações  Atender o cliente com excelência é o foco do nosso time de Operações. Nossa missão é conectar as cidades brasileiras por meio de uma logística eficiente, baseada em tecnologia própria, garantindo que os pacotes cheguem ao destino final, transformando sonhos em realidades. O trabalho em equipe é essencial para uma experiência positiva e satisfatória.  Requirements   Experiência em Gerenciamento de Riscos Rodoviários e Prevenção de Perdas  Conhecimento em seguros de transporte e tecnologias de rastreamento  Vivência em análise de PGR e DDR  Experiência em prevenção de perdas voltada ao E-commerce  Gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes  Tomada de decisão assertiva e resiliência  Boa comunicação e capacidade de mediação de conflitos  Perfil analítico e proativo    Responsabilidades   Garantir o cumprimento das regras estabelecidas pela seguradora no plano de gerenciamento de riscos (PGR), por meio de treinamentos e reuniões junto aos transportadores e time de transportes da Loggi, utilizando os indicadores de riscos e performance das transportadoras, propondo planos preventivos para evitar sinistros.  Planejar, controlar e acompanhar a execução das atividades da área de gerenciamento de risco e da gerenciadora de risco contratada, de acordo com os objetivos e metas estabelecidos, distribuindo, orientando e acompanhando o cumprimento das tarefas dos subordinados, assegurando seu alinhamento com os processos, padrões de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.  Realizar a gestão dos contratos de gerenciamento de risco e níveis de serviços dos fornecedores, estabelecendo e acompanhando o cumprimento das especificações técnicas, assegurando a conformidade com os custos, prazos e qualidade estabelecida pela companhia.  Realizar a gestão da apólice de seguro de transportes rodoviário junto à corretora de seguros contratada, analisar tecnicamente as cartas DDR (Dispensa do Direito de Regresso) e PGR (Plano de Gerenciamento de Risco) de clientes e fornecedores, realizar as tratativas de seguro de transporte junto às áreas internas.  Realizar a Governança de Prevenção de Perdas no Transportes identificando riscos no processo de coleta, transferência e entrega final, criando ações, bem como acompanhar a evolução do indicador.  Conduzir projetos para redução de perdas na cadeia logística com foco no transporte.    Benefits   Vale refeição e alimentação no cartão Flash ou refeitório no local de trabalho (regras sujeitas ao modelo definido na regional de atuação e de acordo com a política vigente)  Vale Transporte, com desconto de até 6% do salário, e roteirização realizada por empresa especializada, de acordo com o endereço indicado pelo Logger  Assistência Médica: Mensalidade custeada pela Loggi, com coparticipação em exames simples e consultas, inclusive para filhos de até 21 anos (se universitários, até 24)  Assistência Odontológica: 100% custeado pela Loggi, inclusive para filhos de até 21 anos (se universitários, até 24)  Auxílio home office: Para quem estiver trabalhando no formato remoto ou híbrido  Auxílio creche para filhos com até 5 anos  Auxílio para filho(a) com deficiência: mediante comprovação, laudo com CID validado e aprovado/outros  Licença maternidade/ paternidade: 06 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais  Convênio Farmácia: Subsídio com descontos em redes credenciadas em todo o Brasil  Seguro de vida  Wellhub (antigo Gympass): para treinar em diversas academias, realizar esportes e aulas  Apoio através de parceria para cuidados com a saúde física e mental  Galena: Descontos e bolsas educacionais com diversas opções de cursos em instituições no Brasil (benefício estendido para filhos(as) e cônjuges de Loggers)  Empréstimo consignado (elegível após 3 meses de casa)  Loggi 4Free: para você enviar seus pacotes com a gente (Limitado a R$ 200/mês)  Programa de incentivo (PLR ou Bônus) conforme política vigente, regras aplicadas de acordo com a senioridade da posição    Para conhecer mais sobre a Loggi e outras oportunidades, acesse:     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mobile Engineer (Remote)
description:

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.  As part of Fireblocks, Dynamic represents the next evolution of non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Dynamic is Fireblocks’ embedded wallet platform, purpose-built for developers who want to bring crypto and stablecoin experiences into modern applications without complexity. Together, Fireblocks and Dynamic are building the most complete, secure, and developer-friendly wallet infrastructure in the industry by combining institutional-grade security with consumer-grade experiences.  About the Team  Dynamic was founded in 2021 with a simple vision: every app and website will have a wallet component. That vision is rapidly becoming reality. Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.  Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.  As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks’ core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Explain technical solutions and consult with prospects to present white label, API, and SDK digital banking integration options across multiple digital channels. Support on‑site and virtual sales pitches and client renewals through presentations and demonstrations. Communicate technical requirements and dependencies, pre‑requisites, configuration options, implementation considerations and develop end to end technical flows in partnership with clients. Maintain a deep knowledge of all DES, Visa, and processor related products and services. Maintain deep understanding of DES development roadmap and influence roadmap priorities by communicating client needs to product teams. Deliver product and competitor information to drive and support product development and innovation strategies. Identify and highlight key partnership opportunities across the digital banking industry e.g. (Mobile/online banking providers, processors, etc.) Collaborate with product teams to ensure generalist/specialized sales teams are well educated and up to date on DES products and services. Craft persuasive, technically accurate RFP responses and solution proposals for banks and fintechs. Foster in‑depth and productive relationships at all levels with the client and the Visa organization. Actively lead various ad‑hoc internal projects as assigned. Translate client requirements into clear implementation deliverables (Solution Designs), ensuring readiness before project kickoff. Engage with internal cross functional teams including Product Management, Product Development, Client Support and Product Marketing to relay market feedback and provide input into the design of innovative solutions.  This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 5 years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 3 years of work experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters/MBA/JD/MD)  Preferred Qualifications: 5-8 years or more of work experience with a bachelor’s degree Experience with technical sales, product and management experience in the mobile/online banking and payments industry. Proven history of successful sales and/or relationship management. Ability to manage & grow internal and external resources and cross functional relationships. Ability to work independently and in collaboration with high level of success/achievement. Ability to travel as needed to ensure adequate on‑site interaction with the client. Exceptional customer service and advocacy experience and mindset. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Ability to work across multiple time zones. Spanish is desirable.  Unique Knowledge and Skills: Strong knowledge of mobile/online banking and issuer processing environments including digital issuance and tokenization. Strong knowledge of API/SDK and mobile/online technologies (iOS, Android, Web, etc.) and non‑native mobile app development technologies (React Native, Cordova, etc.). Strong knowledge of modern banking platforms (core systems, issuer processors, networks) and functionality. Superior presentation skills with technical sales acumen. Excellent client engagement and relationship building skills. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to establish effective relationships across all levels of management. Keen interest in innovation and technology. Exceptional ability to manage & foster internal and external resources and cross‑functional relationships. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Comfortable with ambiguity and operating in an environment synonymous with change. Ability through written and verbal communication to articulate complex, technical information adaptable to technical and non‑technical audiences.  Additional Information Visa is an EEO Employer. Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop. Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.  O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.  Sobre a Vaga   O Tech Manager é a ponte que une o produto com a parte técnica visando a entrega e acompanhamento dos projetos, provendo a robustez necessária para que tenhamos escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança para suportar milhares de clientes navegando em nossas plataformas. Sua principal missão é garantir que as ações técnicas se encaixem com as ações globais e vice versa, garantindo que estão sendo tomadas as melhores decisões para o produto no que diz respeito aos sistemas e a arquitetura de infraestrutura. Também é uma de suas missões, dimensionar tamanho e necessidades da equipe, identificando e removendo os impedimentos que não estão ao alcance do próprio time resolver, garantindo visibilidade para dentro e para fora do Squad. Além disso, é a pessoa que faz a gestão do dia a dia dos desenvolvedores da Squad que atua sendo referência para assuntos como: banco de horas, férias, engajamento e clima, dúvidas do dia a dia e feedbacks situacionais, essas decisões devem ser baseadas em dados e métricas tiradas do time e das pessoas. Pré-requisitos e qualificações    Ensino superior completo em áreas correlatas a TI (Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Gestão de TI, Sistemas da Informação etc.) ou Ciências Exatas;  Conhecimento de Tecnologia, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Nuvem, Agilidade, Arquitetura de Sistemas, Banco de Dados;  Programação Orientada a Objetos;  Bancos de Dados (SQL ou NoSQL);  Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;  Java 17+ (ou outra linguagem de programação);  Design de APIs REST, System Design; ReactJS ou ReactNative (Desejável). Para ser cliente da Livelo não precisa ser correntista de determinado banco, voar por determinada companhia aérea, ser portador de determinado cartão, nem mesmo possuir um cartão de crédito. Basta entrar no site e se cadastrar com um CPF válido.  Aqui, o participante conta com mais de 800 mil opções de resgate de produtos e serviços reunidos em um marketplace próprio. No programa, é possível acumular pontos de diferentes formas, seja por meio dos gastos nas lojas parceiras, pela assinatura do Clube Livelo, pelos gastos em diversos cartões de crédito elegíveis, trazendo de outros programas parceiros ou até recebendo pontos da empresa na qual o participante da Livelo trabalha, caso ela seja uma parceira Livelo Incentivo.  Atualmente, temos parcerias estratégicas com grandes empresas e lojas de diversos setores, como varejo online, moda, lazer e entretenimento, alimentos e bebidas, serviços, turismo, ONGs, entre outros. Também contamos com uma agência de viagens online, na qual o participante pode resgatar passagens por mais de 750 companhias aéreas em destinos nacionais e internacionais, reservar hotel ou alugar um carro no Brasil e no mundo utilizando pontos.  Nosso participante ainda tem a liberdade de transferir seus pontos para os principais programas de companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais, comprar pontos ou assinar o Clube Livelo, com pontos que nunca expiram, potencializando suas recompensas. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura. Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):   Coordenação do Processo de Gestão de Incidentes    Assegurar que todos os incidentes sejam identificados, classificados, priorizados e tratados  conforme a política  Receber notificações, avaliar informações iniciais e direcionar as ações às equipes competentes (TI, NOC, SOC, segurança, negócio).  Garantir o cumprimento das etapas formais: notificação, classificação (incluindo NISI), planejamento de ação, execução, registro (RISI) e encerramento.    Comunicação Corporativa de Incidentes    Definir e operar um plano de comunicação claro , adequado à severidade:   Comunicação simples para incidentes de baixa criticidade;  Comunicação estruturada para incidentes médios e altos;  Comunicação imediata para Diretoria, Jurídico, áreas de negócio e parceiros críticos nos incidentes graves.    Garantir consistência e precisão nas informações compartilhadas.    Integração com Mudanças e Problemas (ITIL/COBIT)    Coordenar identificação de mudanças necessárias  decorrentes de incidentes críticos ou recorrentes.  Apoiar abertura de problemas , especialmente quando houver causa raiz não compreendida ou reincidência.  Integrar os três ciclos (Incidentes–Problemas–Mudanças) para:  Prevenir reincidências;  Garantir implementações em janelas seguras (finais de semana/horários restritos);  Incorporar aprendizados no catálogo de mudanças e melhorias.        Governança e Post Mortem    Conduzir ou coordenar análises pós-incidente (post mortem)  para incidentes de criticidade alta.  Elaborar relatórios executivos consolidando causas, impacto, falhas de processo, gaps de controles e recomendações.  Propor ações preventivas e corretivas ao Comitê de Segurança e às diretorias.    Atividades‑Chave da Posição    Centralizar a gestão de incidentes  em um único ponto de coordenação.  Garantir que incidentes sejam tratados dentro dos SLAs definidos , com escalonamento adequado.  Manter rotinas regulares com NOC/SOC  para correlação, investigação e priorização de eventos.  Construir dashboards executivos  (status, tendências, tempos de resposta, severidade, reincidência).  Estabelecer critérios claros de severidade , fundamentados em impacto ao negócio, clientes e requisitos regulatórios.  Gerenciar incidentes de segurança , respeitando procedimentos de cadeia de custódia, privacidade e sigilo.  Acionar comitês e lideranças conforme classificação e natureza do incidente .    Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):    Domínio de práticas ITIL (principalmente Incident, Problem e Change Management).  Conhecimento das políticas de segurança da informação e continuidade de negócios.  Capacidade de analisar logs, eventos, evidências e correlações de NOC/SOC.  Familiaridade com ferramentas de SIEM, gestão de incidentes, monitoramento e governança.    Informações adicionais:    Modelo 100% presencial, na Av Paulista;  Jornada de 2ª a 6ª - das 9h às 18h. title: Senior Full Stack Ruby on Rails Engineer (Frontend)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Full Stack Ruby on Rails Engineer (Frontend) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Full Stack Ruby on Rails Engineer (Frontend) Join to apply for the Senior Full Stack Ruby on Rails Engineer (Frontend)  role at SK Intertainment, Inc.  We're looking for a mid-to-senior Full-Stack Ruby on Rails Developer with a strong frontend focus to lead the charge on our Rails-based applications in the adult entertainment space. Our flagship product, Mr. Skin, has been online for over 25 years and continues to attract millions of visitors each month, and now we're making it faster, sleeker, and easier to maintain! While new applications and services may use Node.js, Rails remains at the core of our platform. You should be comfortable working in Rails views (ERB, Haml) and parts of the legacy frontend (Backbone, jQuery, Bootstrap 3), while also introducing modern design systems and reusable components to improve performance and maintainability. You'll be the go-to person for all things frontend in a product team of 4 developers, QA, and DevOps, working closely with the lead engineer and backend developers across Rails and Node.js services. If you're a proactive self-starter, you'll fit right in! This role is perfect for someone who values autonomy and enjoys shaping how our frontend evolves. What You'll Do  Maintain and modernize frontends built with Rails views, Backbone, jQuery, and Bootstrap 3. Refactor and migrate legacy code to TypeScript, React, Web Components, and Bootstrap 5. Build new frontends for Node.js applications, ensuring consistency with our design systems and modern stack. Create and maintain design systems that keep our components, typography, and styling looking sharp and consistent. Improve Core Web Vitals, implement SEO changes, and run A/B tests to boost conversions. Write unit tests with Jest and maintain high-quality code standards. Collaborate closely with the team to deliver features that impact millions of visitors.  What We're Looking For  Comfort working with Ruby on Rails and Node.js backend tasks. Comfortable refactoring and improving legacy code. You're not afraid to dive in and clean things up. Experience working with a design system approach. UX mindset with an eye for design. You know how to make things look beautiful and work great. Curious about analytics and data-driven design decisions. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.  Why Work With Us?  Work from anywhere as part of a remote-first international team. Own the frontend in a small, collaborative team where your decisions directly shape the product. Build and improve high-traffic platforms that have influenced the adult entertainment industry for over two decades. Enjoy a culture of autonomy where your impact is visible from day one and growth opportunities are everywhere. Become a true Skinner!  Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Job function Information Technology Industries Technology, Information and Media Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at SK Intertainment, Inc. by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Research and Development Manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Research and Development Manager em piracicaba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Join to apply for the Senior Research and Development Manager  role at InPlanet  2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants Join to apply for the Senior Research and Development Manager  role at InPlanet  Direct message the job poster from InPlanet Head of People @ InPlanet  | the-ROCK-IT  | Brazil | Climate | Art x Science About InPlanet REMOTE WITHIN BRAZIL (ideally SP)  Fluency in English and Portuguese both written and oral  We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics. People-first, Performance Culture:  We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here About the Role As our Senior Research and Development (R+D) Manager  you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as addressing fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary. The Impact you can make  This role will oversee and manage team members and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead on our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Core working relationships  Reporting to the Head of Science and Research (Christina), you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will manage and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead (Phil). Key Responsibilities Management of team members within our R+D programme Overseeing and planing our R+D programme such as design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders Generating, analysing, presenting and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies You drive research and the wider science team strategy You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil You will work flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)  You can be a Rock-Star if you have Core Skills & Experience  You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields You have, ideally, 5+ years experience in senior research or research related roles You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, ideally with a focus on agronomy or a related field You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g. from industry, government and academia. You have knowledge of geology, geochemistry and weathering processes You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials You are fluent in Portuguese You have advanced English language skills You are based in Brazil  Key Qualities  You are a thought-leader and able to breakdown complex topics and present them in a clear and concise way You are independent, confident, hands-on, a go-getter, full of energy and possess an exceptional drive You are a fast learner and want to steadily improve your professional and personal skill set You are a team player, willing to work with and support others in the team where necessary including actively volunteering for tasks to assist where appropriate  Bonus Points (but not essential)  Industry (CDR) and management experience is a real plus You are **based near Piracicaba (SP) or happy to relocate Experience with OKR goal setting  Living Our Values At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal. Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency Impact:  You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change Salary  expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly Share options  to make you feel like an owner Home Office Budget  Fully Remote:  Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones). Language Programme  Monthly Allowance 34+ days  annual leave The opportunity to be autonomous,  make a huge difference and belong to a vision. Occasional off-sites  in Brazil yay & travel! Laptop  to fuel your productivity  InPlanet Compensation Philosophy At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilise geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognising the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency. Application Process Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening. Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation) Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)  (optional third interview) Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed) Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling Offer  To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter How to Apply We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).  Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning. Seniority level Seniority level Director  Employment type Employment type Full-time  Job function Job function Research Industries Climate Technology Product Manufacturing  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at InPlanet by 2x We’re unlocking community knowledge in a new way. Experts add insights directly into each article, started with the help of AI.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

We believe great people build great brands. And we know there is Nothing Better in the Market than a career at Brown-Forman. Being a part of Brown-Forman means you will grow both personally and professionally. You will have the opportunity to solve problems, seize opportunities, and generate bold ideas. You will belong to a place where teamwork matters and where you are encouraged to bring your best self to work.  What You Can Expect:  Tax Compliance and Tax Accounting:   Lead the accurate and timely completion of all monthly and annual tax and informational filings to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Municipal tax laws (covering direct and indirect taxes)  Ensure that the tax books and accounting tax records are correctly and timely recorded and aligned with Brown-Forman accounting guidelines, CPC (Brazilian Accounting Pronouncements Committee), and IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)  Review and approve the U.S. GAAP and statutory calculations for taxable income, current tax, and deferred tax, as well as the annual tax true‑up adjustment  Coordinate and supervise the submission of the various tax reporting files to Corporate Tax (quarter and annual), including quarterly forecasts of U.S. GAAP income before taxes and tax expense  Ensure tax obligations are submitted in the Government system:  SPED Tax and Accounting  SPED Contributions      Update billing and tax accounting systems (SAP and BFSO) in accordance to changes in legislation of PIS, COFINS, Excise Tax, Importation Tax, Income Tax and protocols related to ICMS‑ST  Control withholding tax on services to third parties (IR, ISS, INSS, PCC)  Perform/review monthly accounting reconciliations of taxes (PIS/COFINS/Excise Tax/ICMS/ICMS‑ST) of goods, fixed assets, material promotion, etc    Brazilian Tax Reform and Strategic Tax Management:   Lead the Company’s response to the Brazilian Tax Reform  Analyze draft legislation and proposed changes to assess the impact on Brown‑Forman Brazil’s tax burden, systems, and compliance processes  Develop and execute transition plans for adapting billing, tax determination, and accounting systems (SAP) to comply with new legislation  Oversee the process for securing the data requested by transfer pricing consultants to meet Brazil transfer pricing documentation requirements; review the draft reports prepared by the consultants and provide comments to ensure reports are completed timely and efficiently  Review intercompany transactions, including relevant transfer pricing strategies and necessary documentation  Proactively develop and propose tax strategies to help improve/reduce Brown‑Forman Brazil´s tax liabilities by working with Corporate Tax teams, external consultants, and the different industry chambers such as Abrabe e ABBD  Provide guidance and support to the organization regarding tax guidelines and rules    Audit and Team Development:   Coordinate and supervise information submitted to internal and external auditors and different Brazilian authorities  Prepare information to respond to tax authority requests; prepare information for tax audits and collaborate on reviews to guarantee a successful outcome  Communicate status to the different stakeholders and follow up on progress and completion  Coordinate and approve the completion of the quarterly tax audit questionnaire submission to Corporate Tax and provide additional updates to the Director of Tax Audits at Corporate as necessary  Follow up on open tax credits and proactively implement strategies to recover/compensate promptly  Lead, develop and motivate team members to reach personal, department and Company goals  Actively participate in different forums within the industry, such as the Brazilian Beverages Association (Abrabe & ABBD), to understand potential tax reforms and the impacts on BFB´s tax obligations and proactively defend the company´s interests  Develop and maintain a professional network of peers within the BFB office  Maintain a network with consultants and regulating bodies to ensure BFB is updated on changes in laws and regulations  Participate/lead projects as required    What You Bring to the Table:   Bachelor of Accounting Sciences, Administration, Economy or Similar  7+ years in similar positions  High‑level experience in Brazilian tax legislation and technical tax requirements  Proficient in English (oral and written)  Experience in SAP or a similar ERP  Proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets  Experience as a people manager, training and developing teams  Experience in multi‑national organizations with a broad global presence    What Makes You Unique:   Experience in the beverage industry and/or consumer goods industry  Post‑degree in tax regulation and/or tax strategy  Strong analytical skills  Initiative and forward‑thinking  Ability to work collaboratively with other areas of the organization and external partners  Negotiation and decision‑making skills  Strategic thinking  Time and resource management  Communication and storytelling skills  Proven desire to improve processes and adapt to an ever‑changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment    Who We Are  We believe great people build great brands. And we know there is Nothing Better in the Market than a career at Brown‑Forman. Being a part of Brown‑Forman means you will grow both personally and professionally. You will have the opportunity to solve problems, seize opportunities, and generate bold ideas. You will belong to a place where teamwork matters and where you are encouraged to bring your best self to work.  What We Offer  Total Rewards at Brown‑Forman is designed to engage our people to ensure sustainable and profitable growth for generations to come. As a premium spirits company, we offer equitable pay structures for individual and company performance alongside a premium employee experience. We offer a range of premium benefits that reflect our company values and meet the needs of our diverse workforce.  Brown‑Forman Corporation is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. It is the policy of Brown‑Forman Corporation to provide full and equal employment opportunities to all employees and potential employees without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, veteran status, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability or any other legally protected status.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Join or sign in to find your next job  Join to apply for the Country Manager  role at AMVAC BR   Direct message the job poster from AMVAC BR  Grow Your Career with a Leader in Sustainable Agriculture – We’re Hiring a Country Manager for our Brazil Office!   At American Vanguard, we’re not just offering a job — we’re offering a path to purpose. If you’re the kind of professional who wants to be part of something bigger, thrives on challenges, and is ready to help shape the future of agriculture — we want to hear from you.  Who We Are:  With over 50 years of experience, American Vanguard  Corporation (NYSE: AVD) is a U.S.-based global company providing technology solutions for agriculture and related industries. We help growers increase yields, protect their crops, and tackle today’s challenges through science‑driven and sustainable innovations. Our portfolio includes trusted crop protection products, nutrient management tools, and advanced delivery systems.  We serve a wide variety of crops — from corn and soybeans to vegetables and specialty crops — and are deeply committed to environmental stewardship, sustainable practices, and meaningful partnerships. At American Vanguard , we are advancing agriculture through innovation, sustainability, and real‑world results.  About the Position:  The Brazil Director is responsible for leading all related aspects needed for the success of Amvac Brazil. Its position has to create the commercial strategy capable to capture the opportunity of the Crop Protection and Green Solution market and create value for all of our stakeholders. The Director must lead with passion and promote a culture aligned with company values.  Key Responsibilities:  Commercial, Sales and Business Management   Responsible for managing all operations within Brazil.
